name: @aikanban/plugin-client
description: AIKanBan browser-half UI library: the board panel and palette entry registered into DSH client slots. Bundled into @aikanban/dsh-aikanban's client bundle — never shipped or loaded on its own.
comment:tsdown: Not bundled here on purpose. This package is a library that the DSH-addressed bundle in packages/plugin resolves INTO its single window.__ModuleLoader__.load registration; a second bundle of its own would register the same plugin id twice.
